headline: AI-powered dating app scams surface
summary: Security researcher uncovers fraudulent AI dating app, Dora. App features AI-generated personas for scamming users. Calls attention to new risks in AI-driven online dating.

headline: Xreal 1S Video Glasses Hit Lowest Price
summary: Xreal 1S USB-C video glasses are on sale for $399, $50 off. Experience games, movies, and computer screens on an immersive virtual display. Deal available at Amazon and Xreal directly.

headline: Top AI Execs Urge Regulation
summary: Leading AI executives are publicly advocating for increased regulation. This includes CEOs from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, and Microsoft. They warn of potential loss of control without proper safeguards.

headline: Nintendo Expands Fire Emblem with Fortune's Weave
summary: Nintendo introduces open-ended gameplay to the Fire Emblem series. New title, Fortune's Weave, follows Zelda's open-world success on Switch 2. Players gain freedom to explore the map similar to Breath of the Wild.

headline: Spider-Man: Brand New Day Sets Box Office Record
summary: Spider-Man: Brand New Day becomes North America's highest-grossing film ever. It surpasses previous record-holder Star Wars: The Force Awakens. This marks a significant milestone for the Spider-Man franchise.

headline: Last Chance for Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave Discount
summary: Get $10 off physical copies of Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave for Nintendo Switch 2. This limited-time offer ends today. Don't miss out on saving on the new Fire Emblem title.

headline: Baby's Birthplace: 'Cineworld' After Harry Potter Screening
summary: A baby girl was born during a Harry Potter movie screening. Her official place of birth is now listed as 'Cineworld.' This unique event made headlines for its unusual circumstances.

headline: MindsEye Developers Laid Off; Studio's Future Uncertain
summary: Multiple developers from MindsEye report being laid off. This raises concerns about the future of developer Build A Rocket Boy. The studio has faced controversy over its game's development.

headline: CCTV Reveals Last Sighting of Noah Woods
summary: Suffolk Police released CCTV footage of Noah Woods. The last confirmed sighting was in Brantham park on Tuesday at 14:37 BST. Authorities are continuing their search efforts.

headline: 'Putney Pusher' Suspect Found Dead
summary: Nicholas Brandram, suspect in the 'Putney pusher' case, has died. He was linked to the 2017 incident where a woman was shoved into a bus's path. His death was confirmed at his home.

headline: EU Chief Backs Canada's 'Associate Member' Plan
summary: The EU chief supports Canada's bid for 'associate member' status. Canada seeks closer ties with the EU. This follows strained relations with the US under President Donald Trump.

headline: Photos Detail Damage from Iranian Attacks on US Sites
summary: Images reveal extensive damage at US sites targeted by Iranian attacks. Photos, obtained by CBS News, show wrecked aircraft and destroyed buildings. The visuals highlight the severity of the strikes.
